Sam: Short follow-up from today’s All-hands pricing Q&A. Pulling together the couple of edge-case questions we didn’t have time for. @Paula can you confirm answers here?
Paula: Yep, go ahead.
Sam: 1) Do monthly credits apply to Dedicated reserved capacity fees or just per-token usage?
Paula: Credits only offset metered usage (per-token and per-embedding units). Dedicated committed fees are separate line items and not reduced by monthly hosted credits unless contract schema says otherwise. For enterprise we can roll custom credit terms into the contract.
Leah: 2) If an org has multiple projects under one account, can we allocate quotas per project?
Paula: You can create scoped API keys and set per-key rate limits and per-project quotas via the Console today for Dedicated/Private. Hosted self-serve will get a per-project quota UI next sprint.
Sam: 3) Are warnings only via email/console, or do we have webhook alerts for billing thresholds?
Paula: We provide webhook alerts for billing threshold events (80/95/100%) and a Console banner. We'll add a sample webhook consumer to the docs repo.
DevBot: System: sample webhook template uploaded to internal repo at https://internal.redwood/billing/webhook-samples
Leah: 4) For teams using shared admin keys, what's the recommended mitigation for accidental overage? Any auto-suspend?
Paula: We do not auto-suspend for overage by default; we send multiple alerts and pause new provisioning flows for unpaid invoices. Recommend: use per-service keys, set conservative quotas, and enable billing webhooks so SRE can auto-scale or pause jobs.
Sam: 5) Pricing question: are embedding calls metered differently in burst scenarios? If embeddings spike, are they prioritized/queued differently?
Paula: Embeddings are metered per-unit like other endpoints. Priority/queuing policies can be configured on Dedicated via route policies; hosted will respect soft-priority tiers (enterprise first, then paid, then free) for queuing. We plan a doc page that shows a worked example of a mixed-workload account with separate embedding/chat quotas.
Sam: Thanks. Action items: @Paula to add webhook examples + worked mixed-workload billing example, @Leah to draft customer-facing one-pager for CS. I’ll mark this closed once the docs are linked.
Paula: ETA for docs: 5 business days.
Sam: Great, leaving this thread open until then. :thumbsup:
